rows.name: DICE_ALLOW_TEST_HOST_CONFIG
rows.section: 2. Dice, Slice and the launcher wrappers

cells.Read by: `dice`, `slice` and the wrappers (`bin/dice`, `bin/slice`, `bin/rinzler` and 1 more file)
cells.Set by: The test fixtures of Dice and Slice.
cells.Values and default: Exactly `1` allows the override. Any other text does not. Unset: a set `DICE_TEST_HOST_CONFIG_PATH` is an error in `bin/dice`, `bin/slice` and the wrappers. The error contains `DICE_TEST_HOST_CONFIG_PATH is test-only`.
cells.Effect: Gives the permission that `DICE_TEST_HOST_CONFIG_PATH` needs. That variable replaces `/etc/positron/dice.yaml` (the Dice host configuration file) with a test file. Without that variable, `DICE_ALLOW_TEST_HOST_CONFIG` changes nothing. The override needs `PYTEST_CURRENT_TEST` and a Git checkout. Pytest must be the process or one of its 5 nearest ancestors. `DICE_TEST_HOST_CONFIG_SPAWN_OK` gives one exception. A shared host needs `DICE_ALLOW_TEST_HOST_CONFIG_SHADOW_SHARED`. Outside an override, the Dice daemon removes it from the environment of the programs it starts.

rows.name: DICE_ALLOW_TEST_HOST_CONFIG_SHADOW_SHARED
rows.section: 2. Dice, Slice and the launcher wrappers

cells.Read by: `dice`, `slice` and the wrappers (`bin/dice`, `bin/slice`, `bin/rinzler` and 1 more file)
cells.Set by: The test fixtures of Dice and Slice.
cells.Values and default: Exactly `1` enables it. Any other text is off. Unset: on a shared host, `bin/dice` rejects a `DICE_TEST_HOST_CONFIG_PATH` that names another file than `/etc/positron/dice.yaml`.
cells.Effect: Lets `DICE_TEST_HOST_CONFIG_PATH` replace the Dice host configuration file on a shared host (a server whose `/etc/positron/dice.yaml` sets `mode: shared`). The error contains `DICE_TEST_HOST_CONFIG_PATH is disabled`. `DICE_ALLOW_TEST_HOST_CONFIG` must also be `1`. When `bin/dice` is missing, `bin/slice` and the wrappers ignore the override and print no such error. The Dice daemon does not remove this variable from the environment of the programs it starts.

hints.problem: Rule 2 (a claim without its subject). "The error" refers to nothing in this cell. It is the error of the rejection that only the "Values and default" cell mentions. Original phrase: "The error contains `DICE_TEST_HOST_CONFIG_PATH is disabled`."
hints.suggested: Replace the whole cell with: Lets `DICE_TEST_HOST_CONFIG_PATH` replace the Dice host configuration file on a shared host (a server whose `/etc/positron/dice.yaml` sets `mode: shared`). Without it, the override is rejected with an error that contains `DICE_TEST_HOST_CONFIG_PATH is disabled`. `DICE_ALLOW_TEST_HOST_CONFIG` must also be `1`. When `bin/dice` is missing, `bin/slice` and the wrappers ignore the override and print no such error. The Dice daemon does not remove this variable from the environment of the programs it starts.

hints.problem: Rule 1 (grammar). "another file than" is not standard English. Original phrase: "that names another file than `/etc/positron/dice.yaml`."
hints.suggested: Replace the whole cell with: Exactly `1` enables it. Any other text is off. Unset: on a shared host, `bin/dice` rejects a `DICE_TEST_HOST_CONFIG_PATH` that names a file other than `/etc/positron/dice.yaml`.

rows.name: DICE_ALLOW_TEST_RUNNER
rows.section: 2. Dice, Slice and the launcher wrappers

cells.Set by: The tests of the LSF bridge in `bin/slice-tests`.
cells.Values and default: Exactly `1` enables it. Any other text is off. Unset: the hidden option `--runner` must name the `bin/dice-lsf-runner` of the same checkout.
cells.Effect: Lets `bin/dice-lsf-submit` (the script that submits a Dice job to LSF) accept a `--runner` path that is not the `bin/dice-lsf-runner` beside it. Without it, another `--runner` path ends the script with the error `--runner is reserved for bridge tests` and exit status 2.

hints.problem: Rule 8 and 1. Terms with no explanation: "`C0.1`" and "`C0.2`" (two idle states of Intel CPUs), "ledger" in "the ledger code of the CI model cache", "the runner" (a CI machine), "the flake source", "the LSF bridge". In `GIT_TERMINAL_PROGRESS` the quoted source comment is not marked as a quote.
hints.suggested: Suggested text: "labels `1` as `C0.1` and `0` as `C0.2` (two idle states of Intel CPUs)"; "`hf_cache.py` (the code that keeps the version record of the CI model cache)"; "the Nix installation of the CI runner (the machine that runs the job)"; "The source comment says: `make git tell us what is happening`." The author must supply the clause for "flake source" and "LSF bridge".

rows.name: DICE_LOCK_PATH
rows.section: 2. Dice, Slice and the launcher wrappers

cells.Values and default: A file path. The text is used as given. Unset: `dice.lock` in the Dice runtime directory. That directory is `/run/dice` on a shared host.
cells.Effect: Moves the lock file that the Dice daemon holds while it runs. A second daemon that uses the same lock file does not start. Only tests can use it. On a shared host outside a `DICE_TEST_HOST_CONFIG_PATH` override, a daemon with this variable does not start. It prints `DICE_LOCK_PATH is test-only in shared Dice`. A client ignores the variable there. On a legacy host no Dice daemon runs.

hints.problem: One function in `bin/dice` handles all six path overrides, and one loop removes all six from the environment of the programs that the daemon starts. The six rows describe this in two ways. Three rows say that `bin/dice` stops, and that the daemon removes the variable from the environment of the programs it starts. The other three say that "a daemon with this variable does not start" and "A client ignores the variable there", and they say nothing about the removal.
hints.suggested: Append to the Effect cells of `DICE_LOCK_PATH`, `DICE_LOG_DIR` and `DICE_LOG_PATH`: "Without that override, the daemon removes the variable from the environment of programs it starts." Use one Set by text for the six rows, for example "The Dice and Slice tests." (today: "The Dice tests.", "The Dice test fixtures.", "The Dice and Slice tests.").

rows.name: DICE_RUNTIME_DIR
rows.section: 2. Dice, Slice and the launcher wrappers

rows.name: DICE_STATE_PATH
rows.section: 2. Dice, Slice and the launcher wrappers

cells.Read by: `bin/dice`. `bin/slice` loads `bin/dice` as a module and reads it there.
cells.Values and default: Path of a file. The text is used as given. Unset: `dice.state.json` in the Dice runtime directory (`DICE_RUNTIME_DIR`).
cells.Effect: Moves the file in which the Dice daemon records its running, queued and finished work. `bin/slice` reads the same file. With `mode: shared` in `/etc/positron/dice.yaml`, `bin/dice` stops with `DICE_STATE_PATH is test-only in shared Dice`, unless the test override `DICE_TEST_HOST_CONFIG_PATH` is active. The Dice daemon runs only with `mode: shared`. Without that override, the daemon removes the variable from the environment of programs it starts.

hints.problem: With `mode: shared` in `/etc/positron/dice.yaml`, `bin/dice` stops with `DICE_STATE_PATH is test-only in shared Dice`, unless the test override `DICE_TEST_HOST_CONFIG_PATH` is active. => The check runs only where the state path is resolved. `state_path()` has three callers in `bin/dice`: `_secure_runtime_tree` (line 598) and `Daemon.__init__` (lines 1926 and 1952). On a shared host without the test override, `ensure_daemon` returns at lines 4147 to 4154, before `ensure_runtime_dir`. So client commands of `bin/dice` (`submit`, `queue`, `cancel`) never call `state_path()`. They ignore the variable and do not stop. Only the daemon stops at startup. `bin/slice` also stops, with `error: DICE_STATE_PATH is test-only in shared Dice`, in the commands that read the state file (`dice_state_snapshot`, bin/slice:5393, called from bin/slice:952, 6028, 6214 and 6262). The sibling rows `DICE_LOCK_PATH` and `DICE_LOG_PATH` already say `A client ignores the variable there`. (bin/dice:433)
hints.suggested: Moves the file in which the Dice daemon records its running, queued and finished work. `bin/slice` reads the same file. Only tests can use it. With `mode: shared` in `/etc/positron/dice.yaml`, a Dice daemon with this variable does not start. It prints `DICE_STATE_PATH is test-only in shared Dice`. A `bin/slice` command that reads the state file stops with the same message. A client command of `bin/dice`, such as `submit`, ignores the variable there. The check does not apply while the test override `DICE_TEST_HOST_CONFIG_PATH` is active. The Dice daemon runs only with `mode: shared`. Without that override, the daemon removes the variable from the environment of programs it starts.

rows.name: DICE_TEST_HOST_CONFIG_PATH
rows.section: 2. Dice, Slice and the launcher wrappers

cells.Values and default: Path of a file with `key: value` lines. `bin/dice` reads the keys `mode` (`legacy` or `shared`) and `socket` (an absolute path). Unset: the programs read `/etc/positron/dice.yaml`. A missing file means `mode: legacy`.
cells.Effect: The Dice programs take the host mode and the socket path from this file and not from `/etc/positron/dice.yaml`. While the override is active, `bin/dice` accepts path overrides such as `DICE_RUNTIME_DIR` with `mode: shared`. It also starts the daemon itself and not through `dice.service`. The override needs `DICE_ALLOW_TEST_HOST_CONFIG=1`, a `PYTEST_CURRENT_TEST` that is not empty, `bin/dice` inside a git checkout, and a pytest command among the process and its 5 nearest ancestors. Otherwise a set value stops `bin/dice` with an error. With `mode: shared` in `/etc/positron/dice.yaml`, it also needs `DICE_ALLOW_TEST_HOST_CONFIG_SHADOW_SHARED=1`.

hints.problem: The override needs ... a pytest command among the process and its 5 nearest ancestors. => `_cmdline_is_pytest` accepts only three forms of command line: the argument `-m` followed by `pytest`, the argument `--from` followed by `pytest` with a later argument `pytest`, or a first argument whose file name is `pytest` and whose path contains `/.cache/uv/`. A `pytest` program started directly from another place (for example from a virtual environment) is not recognized. `bin/dice` then stops with `DICE_TEST_HOST_CONFIG_PATH is test-only and is disabled outside pytest`. The count of the process plus 5 ancestors is right (`range(6)`). `bin/slice`, `bin/rinzler` and `bin/runtron` hold the same test in their fallback code. (bin/dice:321)
hints.suggested: The Dice programs take the host mode and the socket path from this file and not from `/etc/positron/dice.yaml`. While the override is active, `bin/dice` accepts path overrides such as `DICE_RUNTIME_DIR` with `mode: shared`. It also starts the daemon itself and not through `dice.service`. The override needs `DICE_ALLOW_TEST_HOST_CONFIG=1`, a `PYTEST_CURRENT_TEST` that is not empty, `bin/dice` inside a git checkout, and a pytest command line among the process and its 5 nearest ancestors. Only three forms of command line count: `-m pytest`, `--from pytest` with a later `pytest` argument, and a program named `pytest` below a `/.cache/uv/` directory. A `pytest` program that is started directly from another place does not count. `DICE_TEST_HOST_CONFIG_SPAWN_OK` gives one exception for a detached daemon. Otherwise a set value stops `bin/dice` with an error. With `mode: shared` in `/etc/positron/dice.yaml`, it also needs `DICE_ALLOW_TEST_HOST_CONFIG_SHADOW_SHARED=1`.

rows.name: DICE_TEST_HOST_CONFIG_SPAWN_OK
rows.section: 2. Dice, Slice and the launcher wrappers

cells.Set by: `bin/dice`, when it starts a detached daemon under pytest.
cells.Values and default: Only the exact text `1` counts. Any other text behaves like unset. Unset: `DICE_TEST_HOST_CONFIG_PATH` needs a pytest command among the process and its 5 nearest ancestors.
cells.Effect: Keeps `DICE_TEST_HOST_CONFIG_PATH` usable in a Dice daemon that was detached from pytest. Such a daemon has no pytest ancestor. It counts only when the command line is `dice daemon run`, the parent process id is `1`, `PYTEST_CURRENT_TEST` is set and `bin/dice` runs from a git checkout. `bin/dice` sets it before it starts a detached daemon, when the test override is active.

rows.name: SLICE_BOX_CAPACITY
rows.section: 2. Dice, Slice and the launcher wrappers

cells.Set by: A person, by hand. Slice test fixtures also set it.
cells.Values and default: Slot count of the server. Integer greater than 0, parsed with `int`. Other text or a count below 1 slot ends the program with an error. Unset: the programs get the slot count from `config/resource-map.yaml` through `config/resource-parser.sh`.
cells.Effect: Sets the number of slots of the server for `bin/slice` and the Dice daemon. It has the same meaning as `DICE_BOX_SLOTS`. `DICE_BOX_SLOTS` is used when both are set. `bin/slice` ignores both when a live Dice daemon reports its slot count. The Dice daemon reads its own environment once at startup. Its option `--box` replaces both. `bin/dice-lsf-runner` removes the variable for the command it starts.

hints.problem: The two variables have the same meaning, and the row of `SLICE_BOX_CAPACITY` says so. Their Set by cells follow different conventions. One names the test fixtures and the other does not, although the Dice test fixture sets `DICE_BOX_SLOTS`.
hints.suggested: Replace the Set by cell of `DICE_BOX_SLOTS` with: "A person, in the environment of the Dice daemon or `bin/slice`. Dice test fixtures also set it."
